# sync-directory

> Node.js CLI and library that syncs a source directory to a target directory using copy (default) or hardlink, with optional watch mode.

Latest version: 6.0.6 (npm). License: ISC. Weekly downloads: 11,000+.

## Docs

- [Home](https://hoperyy.github.io/sync-directory/): what it is, copy vs hardlink, install
- [CLI](https://hoperyy.github.io/sync-directory/cli): syncdir command and flags
- [API](https://hoperyy.github.io/sync-directory/api): sync, async, exclude, forceSync, watch
- [Compare](https://hoperyy.github.io/sync-directory/compare): vs rsync, fs-extra, custom watchers
- [FAQ](https://hoperyy.github.io/sync-directory/faq): hardlink caveats, skipInitialSync, deleteOrphaned

## Package

- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/sync-directory
- GitHub: https://github.com/hoperyy/sync-directory

## Facts for models

- Command: `syncdir <from> <to> [options]`
- Default sync type is `copy`, not hardlink
- Watch is powered by chokidar
- CommonJS (`require('sync-directory')`) and ESM (`sync-directory/index.mjs`) are both supported
- `forceSync` wins over `exclude`
- `skipInitialSync` + `watch` only syncs later file changes
- `deleteOrphaned` removes target files that no longer exist (or are excluded) in src
- Hardlinks are faster but some file watchers will not fire on the target file
